coverage_assessment: Bounded first pass: 36 pooled open-web queries across English, Lao script, and selected Thai, Chinese, and Vietnamese; four January weekly windows; sectoral, geographic, diaspora/location, and December/February boundary checks. Relevant opened, search-only, and inaccessible URLs are recorded, including normal HTTPS recovery after cache misses. Search result pooling, political reporting restrictions, incomplete local-archive coverage, and unresolved official baseline limit coverage. No qualifying January event was established; this is not an absence claim.

temporary_resources_started.resource: One-shot ordinary HTTPS requests to BHRRC, LaoNews, and Thai PBS public URLs after web-tool cache misses
temporary_resources_started.result: All request processes completed. BHRRC returned HTTP 403; LaoNews failed in local DNS before an HTTP response; Thai PBS returned HTTP 200 and the article text was read. No long-running resource was started.

mechanics_assessment: Existing portable scripts cover unit status and consolidation mechanics; this bounded work did not justify creating a new skill or CLI. Most effort was source discovery and evidence review.
